prompt: The usage line doubles the square brackets for optional arguments whose type already puts brackets around its metavar. For example `@click.argument("method", type=click.Choice(["foo", "bar", "baz"]), nargs=-1)` shows `Usage: cli [OPTIONS] [[foo|bar|baz]]...` instead of `[foo|bar|baz]...`, and an optional `click.DateTime(formats=["%Y-%m-%d"])` argument shows `[[%Y-%m-%d]]`. Fix it so these get a single pair of brackets without changing how other arguments are shown, and add a regression test. The existing tests must keep passing.
